urn:eigenius:core:description: A scalar `value` claimed to lie within the closed interval [`lower`, `upper`]. The IntervalArithmetic institution's AutoOnLoad QueryClass dispatches a Julia handler (`validate_bounded_by`) that uses `IntervalArithmetic.jl` to verify the inclusion rigorously: `Holds` when the inclusion is proved, `Fails` when refuted, `Undecidable` when the proof is inconclusive. See D27 §4.0.2.
The scalar value being checked for interval membership.
Inclusive lower bound of the interval the value is claimed to lie within.
Inclusive upper bound of the interval the value is claimed to lie within.
